chapter.heading: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
How long,
O Jehovah? wilt thou forget me for ever? How long wilt thou hide thy face from me?

How long
shall I take counsel in my soul, Having sorrow in my heart all the day? How long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

Consider and
answer me, O Jehovah my God: Lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;

Lest mine
enemy say, I have prevailed against him; Lest mine adversaries rejoice when I am moved.

But I
have trusted in thy lovingkindness; My heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.

I will
sing unto Jehovah, Because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
